name: Ginseng Reishi Notoginseng Capsules
service: OEM / ODM / Private Label Manufacturing / Custom Formulation / Custom Packaging
description: A convenient herbal capsule formula made with selected botanical ingredients including ginseng, reishi mushroom, notoginseng, and goji berry. Formula, capsule specifications, fill quantity, bottle, packaging, and labels can be customized according to private-label customer requirements. OEM/ODM and bulk supply services are available.
